paragraphs: Arakh. R' Elazar ben Arakh: Avot, chapter 2.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פ״ב is expanded as chapter 2. Hyman gives no finer numbering here; no edition-specific reference is independently verified.
ערך functions here as the headword Arakh, the father-name in Elazar ben Arakh, rather than a cross-reference instruction. The abbreviated title remains R'.
